title: White Lace Tie Top & Balloon Skirt
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy auburn hair and a silver hair clip stands against a pale backdrop. She wears a white fitted cap-sleeve top with a lace-trimmed V neckline and a drawstring bow at the center. A black belt with a silver logo buckle sits over a white gathered balloon mini skirt. She carries a black structured handbag. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of white, black, and blush. Sweet and romantic, in the style of a coquette-inspired catalog.
workingNotes:
- The lace trim and balloon hem are the key romantic details.
- Keep the white-on-white palette soft and airy.
